name: Skilled Migrant Category Resident Visa

qualifying_event.description: A points-based direct-to-residence pathway for skilled workers. Points are drawn from qualifications, registered-occupation experience requirements, and income (measured against the SMC wage threshold), plus a bonus for NZ skilled work experience. Applicants submit an Expression of Interest (EOI); if selected, they have 4 months to lodge a full application.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Skilled job offer or current skilled employment with an accredited employer (30+ hrs/week, permanent or 12+ month fixed-term, or 6+ month continuous contracts); qualification and registration evidence; income evidence.

requirements.blocker_text: A minimum of 6 Skilled Resident Points, drawn from qualification points (4-6), occupational registration points (3-6), and income points (3-6, based on multiples of the SMC wage threshold), with up to 3 bonus points available for NZ skilled work experience.
Applicants must be 55 years or younger at the time of application.
A skilled job offer or current skilled employment with an accredited employer, at least 30 hours/week, meeting pathway-specific pay requirements.

evidence_required.document: Skilled job offer or current skilled employment evidence

outcome.duration_length: Resident Visa issued with 24 months of travel conditions

sources.title: Immigration New Zealand -- Skilled Migrant Category Resident Visa: 6-point threshold, qualification/registration/income point bands, age limit 55, EOI-then-invitation process, employer/job requirements

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (New Zealand). The exact dollar-figure breakpoints for each income-points band (which multiple of the SMC wage threshold earns 3 vs 4 vs 6 points) were reported inconsistently across the sources reviewed in this pass and were NOT modeled as separate hard sub-requirements to avoid asserting an unverified number -- the smc_skilled_resident_points >= 6 threshold and the age/job gates are the only figures modeled as hard, all tier-1 sourced. The SMC wage threshold itself is pegged to NZ's median wage (NZD 35.00/hour effective 9 March 2026 per nz_work_permit.json's tier-3 source), which is used for income points here but is NOT the AEWV general pay floor (that requirement was removed in 2025 -- see nz_work_permit.json). Unlike this dataset's usual immediate-grant naturalisation modeling, work grants a Resident Visa with 24-month travel conditions first, converting to full Permanent Resident Visa only after a separate application (see nz_permanent_resident_visa.json) -- pr_after_months (24) and citizenship_after_months (60) reflect Resident Visa -> Permanent Resident Visa -> citizenship-by-grant's combined minimum timeline (2 years + NZ's 5-year, i.e. 1,350-day, presence requirement measured from resident status, not stacked sequentially -- see nz_citizenship_by_grant.json for the exact citizenship-clock mechanics).
